name: Palo Vanilla Panna Cotta & Tiramisu vs. Limoncello Tart (Citrus Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse
whyItWorks: Palo's Vanilla Bean Panna Cotta, Amaretto Soufflé, and Mascarpone Tiramisu are silky and zero-fiber; the Limoncello Tart is a strict citrus avoid.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Vanilla Panna Cotta (scrape off strawberry seeds), Amaretto Soufflé, or Tiramisu with a Lactaid pill; strictly avoid the Limoncello Tart and Orange Sorbet.
watchOuts: Never order the Limoncello Tart or Blood Orange Sorbet (strict citrus guardrail)
